title: Swanny Ivy drops new single "SLEEPING W/ STRANGERS"
htmlContent:
Swanny Ivy is a talented singer and songwriter who recognizes the power of language and its role in the liberation of consciousness. This understanding is at the core of his creative intention, which he keeps on full display in the release of his recent track "SLEEPING W/ STRANGERS."

In his recent song "SLEEPING W/ STRANGERS," Swanny dives into the mental state of a promiscuous lifestyle with "hookup culture," constantly being promoted via social media/dating apps, nightlife, drugs, and alcohol. Here he penetrates the heart of his fans with one question: "Is this even love?".
